x = v, y = u, z = metres up. Anchor 40.7485288,-73.9859714; bearing 29°, elevation 0. OSM tier envelopes are preserved. The western 23.8 m annex is excluded. No textures: broad bays and bevels are geometry.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "empire-state-building", model "empire-state-building"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/c3921f733df14b41e1f6d15853cce7b343886f17/generators/empire-state-building.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
To fit six materials, folded empire-state-building-window-2 into empire-state-building-window (ΔE 5.9).
